meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将实现任务自动拆分为可合并的PR并完成全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将开发任务拆成多个独立PR并自动走完提交流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate full PR lifecycle from task decomposition to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to split development tasks into independent PRs and automate the submission process

howto.what: Claude 会把实现任务拆成多个最小的可独立合并 PR,每个 PR 用独立 git worktree,通过 ulw-loop 实现并强制有证据的手工 QA,然后创建英文 PR,进入 CI 和 Cubic 验证循环;全通过后默认自动合并并清理 worktree,失败则回到该 PR 修复后重新验证。
howto.when: 当用户要求实现工作以 PR 形式落地时触发,典型话术如 'create a PR'、'implement and PR'、'split into atomic PRs' 等;即使用户只说 'implement X',只要上下文暗示要 PR 交付也触发。

say.note: Claude会走完整PR生命周期并默认自动合并

say.text: 把任务拆成多个原子PR并行提交
say.note: 每个PR有独立worktree和验证流程

say.text: 如果CI或Cubic失败,修好再继续
say.note: 回到对应PR的worktree修复并重新QA

howto.what_en: Claude breaks a task into minimal PRs, each in its own worktree, using ulw-loop with evidence-bound manual QA, writes an English PR, then verifies via CI + Cubic (skip Cubic only on quota exhaustion), auto-merges, cleans up. Failing gates loop back to fix and re-QA.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for implementation work to land as a PR, e.g. 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'split into atomic PRs', etc. Even a bare 'implement X' triggers it if the context implies PR delivery.

say_en.text: Implement this issue and create a PR.
say_en.note: Runs the full PR lifecycle; merge by default.

say_en.text: Split the task into atomic PRs and do them in parallel.
say_en.note: Each PR gets its own worktree and verification.

say_en.text: If CI or Cubic fails, fix it and continue.
say_en.note: Routes back to that PR's worktree to fix and re-QA.
